description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments : Habarakada, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 520011
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and amendment under the Registration of Title Act. It specifically addresses the amendment of parcel numbers in a cadastral map for a defined land parcel in the Gampaha District. The content focuses on land property matters, boundary definitions, and title registration - all characteristics of Land Gazettes (Type 4). There is no mention of government personnel, organizational changes, or any other specialized category that would take precedence over the land classification.
